I kitbashed some arms with special weapons for skitarii attached, and some backpacks to suit. There's also a cable to attach the two together.

The parts used in this remix are unfortunately hard to credit as there was no name attached to the Arc Rifle, arms, and backpack I used, but I think it came from SpankDuck9000. The plasma flask on the plasma pack came from Unraze. The plasma caliver came from MK_hand.

- Power Blades

- Siege Wrecker
